title: Average Timespan of Manually-handled Court Case Compared to One Managed Under Intergrated Case Management System
what_it_is: Average Timespan of Manually-handled Court Case Compared to One Managed Under Intergrated Case Management System

sections.label: ICMS criminal cases and maintenance
sections.summary: About 184,000 criminal cases were filed yearly from 2018 to 2022 on ICMS, which undergoes weekly and monthly maintenance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: An average of around 184,000 criminal cases were filed each year from 2018 to 2022 on ICMS.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: The ICMS currently undergoes scheduled weekly and monthly maintenance, which takes about four or 10 hours, respectively.

sections.label: Manual case management on 7 and 8 February 2023
sections.summary: Average manual case management time was not tracked; under 1% of 2,037 scheduled cases on 7 and 8 February 2023 were adjourned.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: The average time to manage these cases manually on 7 and 8 February 2023, as compared to the average time if the cases had been managed under ICMS, was not specifically tracked.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: Only 16 of the 2,037 criminal cases scheduled on 7 and 8 February 2023, that is, less than 1% of the scheduled cases, had to be adjourned.

sections.label: ICMS maintenance downtime hours
sections.summary: Weekly maintenance takes four hours and monthly 10 hours, about 328 downtime hours or 3.7% of a year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Actually, it is four hours for the weekly maintenance and 10 hours for the monthly one, which are done during times when the Courts are not in operation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: That takes about 328 hours of downtime, out of a total of 8,760 hours in a year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: So, it is about only 3.7% of the hours in a year.

sections.label: Improving and integrating CCMS
sections.summary: Suggestions on integrating the Criminal Case Management System (CCMS) will be taken back and looked into.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I think it is something that we want to continually improve on.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: There are suggestions made on the integration of the Criminal Case Management System (CCMS).

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: That is something we can take back and look into.
